# Tomato Skillet Pasta

- Serves: 2
- Time: 30 min
- Tags: vegetarian, one-pot, skillet

## Ingredients

- 200 g pasta
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1 can (796 ml) diced tomatoes
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp salt

## Nutrition

- Calories: 420 kcal
- Protein: 14 g
- Fat: 12 g
- Carbohydrates: 64 g

## Instructions

1. Soften onion and garlic in olive oil.
2. Add tomatoes and simmer.
3. Stir in cooked pasta and season.
